title: the `list-view` / `list` registrations still declare the react-tier aliases `objectName` (required) and `viewType` as designer inputs after `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 retired both — the second half of objectui#8510
body:
Filing-gate category: ④ a coordination child. This is the second half of objectui#8510 (itself the objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#14791), split out at the triage's direction (`5580304720`: 「⛔ 第二半必须拆卡，不要塞进同一个 PR … 本席建议开在本仓、`domain:ui`，正文照抄卡的 (a)/(b) 两条出口并注明 (b) 需跨仓」). Reader who acts: the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it. Dedupe: objectui issues and PRs updated since 2026-09-18 (1000 walked, open and closed) — `registryOnly` → 1 (objectui#8510), `react-declaration-parity` → 4 (objectui#8510 and three unrelated closed items), `list-view.{0,60}inputs` → 1 (objectui#8510), `(objectName|viewType).{0,80}designer input` → 2 (objectui#8510; objectui#7470, closed, the same class on map / gantt). No card carries this half.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (`session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC`). The first half (five author sites) lands with PR objectui#10600, which closes objectui#8510. This card keeps the half that PR leaves alone.

## What is still live

Measured on objectui `main` `f5178a272` by the objectui#8510 dev (report on objectui#8510):
- `packages/plugin-list/src/index.tsx:76-77` declares `list-view` inputs `{ name: 'objectName', type: 'string', required: true }` and `{ name: 'viewType', type: 'enum' }`.
- `:109-110` declares the same on the `list` alias.
- `:84-85` sets `defaultProps` `objectName: ''` / `viewType: 'grid'`.

The installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0 `REACT_BLOCKS` ListView summary: 「Bind the object with the metadata-tier data source — `data={{ provider: 'object', object: '…' }}` — and pick the visualization with `type`: … the only spellings (the `objectName` / `viewType` aliases are retired).」 objectstack's parity ratchet (`check:react-declaration-parity`) judges registry inputs against node-level keys ∪ the spec block props ∪ the react overlay. With the overlay rows gone, both inputs become `registryOnly` for ListView. The gate is on-demand (`pnpm sdui:manifest` over a real browser), so it reds on the next manifest run, not in CI.

## The two exits (objectui#8510's body, verbatim)

> (a) retire the two designer inputs here, since the metadata host stamps `objectName` and the fold supplies it from `data` — the objectui#7470 class, on plugin-list; or (b) widen the objectstack baseline row deliberately with the reason written down. Not decided here.

(b) lands in objectstack-ai/objectstack, not in this repo.

## Execution: inherits the objectui#7470 ruling

objectui#7470 is this class on map and gantt. Its ruling `5809231477` (UI closure batch 2 item 8, maintainer 「同意」) reads: 「**Ruled: align the registration to the contract.**」 It landed there as PR objectui#10390 and on calendar as PR objectui#10508. Under the inheritance rule (a new branch reuses the mother card's ruling, and only a real semantic difference reopens it), this card goes to `pm:queue` with that ruling. It does not go to the decision box.

- The dev first measures which declared face the `list-view` / `list` registrations serve: the metadata-tier ListView schema (`@object-ui/types`, and `@objectstack/spec`'s own ListView view schema) and the react tier (`REACT_BLOCKS`).
- If no face the registration serves still declares `objectName` / `viewType`, the inputs are aligned to the contract: `data` / `type` in their place, following the objectui#7470 form. ⛔ No renderer read-order change: the fold (objectui#7477) keeps reading both spellings.
- ⛔ If the metadata tier still declares either key while the react tier retired it, that is a real semantic difference between two faces the same registration serves. Stop and report; the card then goes to `needs-user-decision` (triage's own rule in `5580304720`). ⛔ Exit (b) is not taken from this repo.

`priority:p3` and `domain:ui` are inherited from objectui#8510.

<sub>`domain:ui` seat #1 · `session_01BA3nKVUwKQJf8DBxrSVtNC` · split card · 2026-09-25</sub>
